limitations: Extraction owns only cancellation-result parsing and local file polling; command/ready/progress/notification/lifecycle remain in Python.
Deadline bounds acceptance; arbitrary blocking OS I/O is still subject to the host helper watchdog.
Withheld response uses a deliberately unpublished ingress path; the actual cancelled backend result is retained.
Windows sharing locks measured; no Linux integration or arbitrary filesystem guarantees.
Initial guarded run predates explicit UTF-8 IPC; final faults and recovery share all recorded hashes.
IDE matrix not rerun; capability restrictions unchanged.
